plan.summary: Add regression tests to verify __repr__ properly escapes newlines and control characters
plan.analysis: The current implementation uses `!r` format spec which correctly escapes newlines. The issue appears to be a false positive from the scanner. The fix is to add explicit regression tests to ensure this behavior is maintained.

tdd_sequence.description: Create new test file with explicit tests for newline escaping. Tests will PASS immediately since implementation is already correct.
test_cases: test_repr_no_literal_newline - Verify repr(Todo(id=1, text='a\nb')) contains no literal newline
test_repr_single_line_output - Verify repr output is single-line for any text content
test_repr_truncated_text_with_newline - Verify truncated text with newline still escapes properly
test_repr_various_control_characters - Verify tabs, carriage returns, etc. are escaped

tdd_sequence.description: No code change needed - the existing `!r` format spec already handles escaping correctly.
